thread:
kevin: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's partial-chunk surge. Root-ish cause looks like clients reconnecting aggressively when an in-flight stream stalled, causing duplicate init requests and server-side resource thrash. Proposed mitigations below.

jana: Can you sketch the minimal server change? We should avoid large schema flips.

kevin: Minimal server-side: add session_grace_ms + chunk_commit ACKs. Behavior: when session disconnects, we'll hold server-side stream state for session_grace_ms (default 2200ms). If a reconnect from same session_id arrives within that window we attach it instead of starting a fresh stream. Also emit a chunk_commit event after final chunk, so clients know completion explicitly. Config patch (staging):

```yaml
streaming:
  session_grace_ms: 2200  # hold server-side KV for reconnects
  emit_chunk_commit: true
  reconnect_consolidation_window_ms: 2000
  per_session_token_bucket:
    rate: 10
    burst: 30
```

ops-bot: rolling deploy scheduled: infra-canary/streaming-session-grace by jana at 18:30 PT

jana: I'll run a 5% canary for 1h, then 25% for 2h if no regressions. Monitoring: partial_chunk_rate, duplicate-init-count, session_reattach_rate.

olivia: I'll wire a new Redwood Optimize eval: "stream-duplicate-init-detect" with a small script that simulates abrupt client reconnects and checks server chunk continuity. Hooking an alert to the ops channel.

samir: On the SDK side I'll add backoff throttling and prefer soft-reconnect (attach attempt) before hard reconnect. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1301 (js) and /pull/1302 (android). Also adding a short migration note for apps. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

kevin: Observed pattern: spikes often after large bot-runner bursts and when per-session concurrency > 8. Short-term workaround: cap per-session concurrent streams and surface clearer 429 with Retry-After header so clients don't immediately retry.

monitor-bot: canary metrics: partial_chunk_rate -67% at 5% canary window, duplicate-init-count down -82%.

jana: 25% canary rolled, metrics stayed stable, no error budget burn. Planning prod rollout in 1h.

- add metric session_reattach_rate & circuit-breaker -> kevin, ETA +2d, status: todo

olivia: Created recurrence ticket: https://redwood.internal/recurrences/R-STREAM-42 "Recurring partial-chunk spikes on streaming during bot bursts". I scheduled a weekly digest to surface trend regressions.

kevin: Note on customer impact: most user-facing requests were intact; partial responses hit a small subset of long-running sessions. We've already flagged major customers affected and engineering success team will follow up.

samir: Also added a debug header X-Stream-Session to help correlate client reconnects with server session IDs in logs.

kevin: Great. Let's keep the thread as the canonical runbook for this remediation. Reopen if the recurrence tracker flags new regressions.
